The moment everyone has been waiting for has finally arrived. Apple TV subscribers can now stream the first episode of the new season of "Slow Horses," just hours after the platform announced the show had been renewed for two seasons. Watch the trailer for the new season below.

Season 6 of Slow Horses is now available on Apple TV

Apple TV released the first episode of season 6 of "Slow Horses" yesterday, with new episodes airing every Wednesday through October 21.

The show's return comes just one day after Saul Metzstein won the Best Director in a Drama Series award for last season's finale, "Scars," and only a few hours after Apple TV announced the renewal for two seasons.

"Slow Horses" premiered to rave reviews in early 2022, and has since maintained a faster production pace than typical series, averaging more than one season per year.

Expectations are high for the new season, with Awards Buzz calling it the show's best season since its debut.
